label: Appeal Board hearing and decision
detail: A three-member Appeal Board, appointed by the Chair of the Judicial Panel, hears City's appeal in private. It can allow the appeal, dismiss it or vary the Commission's decision. No date has been published.

sources.title: Premier League statement: Manchester City FC appeal decision of independent Commission (2 Oct 2026)

label: Sanction hearing
detail: The Commission decides the sanction at a further hearing, held in private. No date has been published.

sources.title: Premier League Statement: Manchester City FC (29 Sep 2026)

label: Publication of the full decision and appendices
detail: Only a redacted Core Decision is public. The League says it will publish the appendices as soon as its rules allow.

sources.title: Premier League Statement: Manchester City FC (29 Sep 2026)
